issues.main_description_html:
🔌 [Profile] Integrate List Bookmark

Wire the published bookmark folders list on a Profile in the new pages-new flow.

BE: api-go#467 — Profile Published Folder Bookmarks API · Based on pages-new (pages-new/profile/*). Related: Search Published Folder Bookmark (#3172) / Detail (#3171).

🔗 Endpoint (what FE needs)

  • GET {{base_url}}/bookmark/published/profile/:username
  • Headers:
    • Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
    • role (required) — viewer | user | my-user
    • ec (optional) — true for encrypted response (default plain JSON)
  • Params:
    • username (required, path) — profile username
    • page (optional, default 1) · limit (optional, default 9)

Role rules (which role to send)

  • viewer — list a profile's public published folders (not logged-in context).
  • user — list another user's public published folders (blocked/deactive checks apply BE-side).
  • my-user — list the authenticated user's own profile only; sending it for another user's profile → 403.
  • Other roles → 401.

Success response (200)

{
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "valid": true, "version": 0, "messages": "List Published Folder Bookmark Profile",
    "folders": [
      { "slug": "ob97a4a99d3-2026040810361400", "name": "CN Tower",
        "thumbnail": "thumbnail.jpg", "published_at": "2026-07-16T00:00:00Z",
        "total_bookmark": 12 }
    ],
    "total": 24, "page": 1, "limit": 9
  }
}

Empty / errors

  • Empty — profile exists but no published folders → 200 with folders: [], total: 0 → render empty state.
  • 409 Conflict — "User Not Found".
  • 403 Forbidden — my-user used on another profile, or user blocked the target → "This is not your profile".
  • 401 Unauthorized — disallowed role.

Scope

  • Fetch via a facade/service with the correct role (own vs other profile) + page/limit; runDecryption (respect ec) → mapper → signal; render the folder grid (thumbnail, name, total_bookmark, published_at); infinite scroll via page/limit + total. Tapping a folder opens its detail (#3171). No BehaviorSubject, no any.

🧪 Test scenario (for QA)

  1. Load (own profile) — role: my-user → bookmark/published/profile/<me>?page=1&limit=9; own published folders render.
  2. Load (other profile) — role: user/viewer → target's public published folders render.
  3. Fields — each folder shows thumbnail, name, total_bookmark, published_at.
  4. Pagination — scroll → page=2 appends without duplicates; stops at total.
  5. Empty / 409 / 403 / 401 — empty list → empty state; user-not-found / forbidden / unauthorized → clear handling (no crash).
  6. Open — tapping a folder routes to its detail.

Acceptance: profile published-folders list fetched via facade with the correct role + page/limit; fields mapped; empty/409/403/401 handled; folder → detail; no any.

Demo by developer

profile-bookmark.webm

issues.display_title: Issue #3171: [Discover] Integrate API Published Folder Bookmark Detail
issues.main_description_html:
🔌 [Discover] Integrate API Published Folder Bookmark Detail

Wire the published folder bookmark detail page (header + posts) in the new pages-new Discover/Search flow.

BE: api-go#468 — Published Folder Bookmark Detail/Header, api-go#469 — Published Folder Bookmark Posts · List/search: #466 → FE #3172 · UI: Search Discover (#3107). Based on pages-new.

⚠️ Endpoint shape updated (supersedes the earlier #464 note): the detail page now uses two dedicated endpoints — a header endpoint (#468) and a separate posts endpoint with a /posts suffix (#469). FE no longer needs the search result to render the header.

🔗 Endpoint 1 — Folder header (#468)

  • GET {{base_url}}/bookmark/published/:slug
  • Headers: Authorization: Bearer <token> · ec (false = plain, true = encrypted)
  • Params: slug (required, path)
  • Use for: the folder header (name, description, location, category, owner, total_bookmark, thumbnail, potd).

Success (200):

{
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": { "valid": true, "version": 0, "messages": "Published Folder Bookmark",
    "bookmark": {
      "slug": "cn-tower", "name": "CN Tower", "description": "…",
      "location": { "lat": 43.6426, "lng": -79.3871 },
      "location_name": "Toronto", "category_name": "Leisure",
      "published_at": "2026-07-16T00:00:00Z", "potd": false,
      "total_bookmark": { "counter_bookmak": 12 },
      "thumbnail": "thumbnail.jpg",
      "user": { "username": "sunnybreeze", "fullname": "Sunny Breeze", "avatar": "avatar.jpg", "encrypt": "abcd123" }
    } }
}

🔗 Endpoint 2 — Folder posts (#469)

  • GET {{base_url}}/bookmark/published/:slug/posts ← note the /posts suffix
  • Headers: Authorization: Bearer <token> · ec
  • Params: slug (required, path) · page (default 1) · limit (default 10)
  • Use for: the paginated post grid + totals.

Success (200):

{
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": { "valid": true, "version": 0, "messages": "Published Folder Bookmark Detail",
    "posts": [
      { "slug": "post-slug", "username": "sunnybreeze", "avatar": "avatar.jpg",
        "description": "…", "short_description": "…", "long_description": "",
        "thumbnail": "thumbnail.jpg", "post_type": "panorama", "potd": false,
        "counter_view": 48, "counter_like": 3, "counter_comment": 21 }
    ],
    "total_posts": 19, "total_views_all_posts": 328000, "page": 1, "limit": 10 }
}

Errors / rules (both endpoints)

  • 409 Conflict — "Folder Not Found" (bad slug / no visible posts / hidden by deactivated/blocked owner) → render the empty/not-found state, not a hard error.
  • 401 Unauthorized — roles other than viewer / user.
  • Visibility (BE-side; FE just renders): excludes deactivated users, private/non-public posts, unpublished posts, video360; role user also excludes blocked users/posts.
  • ⚠️ Field name is total_bookmark.counter_bookmak (spelling as returned) — map exactly. location is { lat, lng } → map markers.

Scope

  • Two facade calls: getPublishedFolder(slug) (#468 → header) + getPublishedFolderPosts(slug, page, limit) (#469 → posts); runDecryption (respect ec) → mappers → signals; render header + post grid with totals; infinite scroll via page/limit. No BehaviorSubject, no any.

🧪 Test scenario (for QA)

  1. Header — open a published folder → bookmark/published/<slug> (#468) fires; header (name/thumbnail/owner/location/category/total) renders.
  2. Posts — bookmark/published/<slug>/posts?page=1&limit=10 (#469) fires; post grid renders with counts + totals.
  3. Pagination — scroll → page=2 appends without duplicates; totals stable.
  4. 409 — bad slug / no visible posts → empty/not-found state (no crash).
  5. 401 / error — unauthorized or network fail → clear handling; no stuck spinner.
  6. Deep link — refreshing on the detail URL re-fetches both header + posts.

Acceptance: header via #468 + posts via #469 (/posts) fetched through facades with page/limit; total_bookmark.counter_bookmak + location mapped; 409 → empty state; 401/error handled; no any.

Demo by developer

discover-bookmark.webm

🔌 Update Integrate API Search Published Folder Bookmark

Update the Search Published Folder Bookmark integration in the new pages-new flow — it powers the Bookmark tab of Search Discover and now supplies all folder/header data for the published-folder detail page.

BE: api-go#466 — Update API Search Published Folder Bookmark · Pairs with: Published Folder Bookmark Detail (#464) · UI: Search Discover (#3107) · FE: #3131. Based on pages-new.

🔗 Endpoint (what FE needs)

  • GET {{base_url}}/search/folder-bookmark/published
  • Headers: Authorization: Bearer <token>
  • Params:
    • page (optional, default 1)
    • limit (optional, default 8)
    • q (optional) — search published folders by name (name also accepted as a backward-compat alias)
    • category (optional, int) — filter by category_id; 0 or omitted = no category filter
    • include (optional, comma-separated) — limits the response to just those fields, e.g. include=slug,name,thumbnail,user,total_bookmark

✅ Key change: the search response now carries all folder/header data, so the detail page can be rendered from the search result — call /bookmark/published/:slug (#464) only for posts + totals.

Success response (200)

{
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "valid": true, "version": 0, "messages": "Search Published Folder Bookmarks",
    "bookmarks": [
      { "slug": "holiday-places-2024", "name": "Holiday Places", "description": "Places to visit",
        "location": { "lat": -8.409518, "lng": 115.188919 },
        "location_name": "Bali", "category_name": "Leisure",
        "published_at": "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z", "potd": false,
        "total_bookmark": { "counter_bookmak": 5 },
        "thumbnail": "sample.jpg",
        "user": { "username": "tester", "fullname": "Tester Account", "avatar": "avatar.jpg", "encrypt": "abcd123" } }
    ]
  }
}

⚠️ Note the BE field name is total_bookmark.counter_bookmak (spelling as returned) — map it exactly. location is { lat, lng } → use for map markers.

Errors / rules

  • 401 Unauthorized — roles other than viewer / user (viewer is supported).
  • 500 — internal/DB error → clear error state.

Scope

  • Call the endpoint via search.facade.searchBookmarks(q, category, page, limit) with a sensible include; decrypt/map → signal → Bookmark-tab cards (+ map markers from location). Feed folder/header data through to the detail page (#464). Feed-first (empty q = default list), debounced search, category filter, infinite scroll. No BehaviorSubject, no any.

🧪 Test scenario (for QA)

  1. Default — Bookmark tab opens → search/folder-bookmark/published?page=1&limit=8 fires; folders render.
  2. Search — type a query (debounced) → q= applied; results update.
  3. Category — chip filter sends category=<id>; All sends 0/omits it.
  4. include — only the requested fields come back and the cards still render fully.
  5. Detail handoff — tapping a folder opens the detail with header data from this response (no extra header call); only /bookmark/published/:slug fires for posts.
  6. Pagination / 401 / 500 — infinite scroll appends; unauthorized + server error handled cleanly.

Acceptance: search wired with page/limit/q/category/include; total_bookmark.counter_bookmak + location mapped; header handed off to #464 detail; empty/401/500 handled; no any.

🔌 Implement — About Us

Wire the About Us page/content in the new pages-new flow.

Purpose

The About Us page introduces Panorra 360 to users by explaining the platform story, mission, vision, values, community impact, and providing a way for users to contact the team.

The page is designed as a single-page storytelling experience without a table of contents.

Wireframe

Functional Criteria

1. Page Access

  • Users can access the About Us page from the application navigation or footer.
  • The system shall display the About Us page within the existing application layout.
  • The page shall maintain consistent header, sidebar, and footer components.

2. Page Header

The system shall display:

  • Page title: "About Us"
  • Short platform introduction.
  • Breadcrumb navigation.

Example:

Home > Settings > About Us

3. Hero Banner / Our Story Section

The system shall display a hero banner containing:

  • Supporting illustration related to Panorra 360.
  • Storytelling introduction about the platform.
  • Clear explanation of the platform purpose.

Content:

"Welcome to Panorra 360, the social media app that lets you share your world in 360! With Panorra 360, you can publish 360 images and videos to your feed, allowing followers to experience your moments from different perspectives."

The section should explain:

  • Sharing immersive 360 photos and videos.
  • Creating interactive experiences.
  • Connecting users through unique perspectives.

4. Platform Statistics Section

The system shall display key platform statistics using cards.

Each card should contain:

  • Icon.
  • Highlight number.
  • Metric title.
  • Supporting description.

Example statistics:

  • 1M+ Users Worldwide
  • 120+ Cities
  • 25K+ Places
  • 98% User Satisfaction

5. Mission, Vision, and Values Section

The system shall display information about the platform identity.

Sections:

Our Mission

Explain the purpose of Panorra 360 and how it helps users share immersive experiences.

Our Vision

Explain the future goal of becoming a trusted platform for 360 content sharing.

What We Do

Explain platform features and services.

Our Values

Display company principles such as:

  • User First
  • Trust & Safety
  • Community
  • Innovation
  • Simplicity

6. Team Section

The system shall display information about the people behind Panorra 360.

Requirements:

  • Display team introduction.
  • Show team member preview.
  • Provide a visual representation of the team.

No additional navigation button is required.

7. Community Impact Section

The system shall display the platform contribution to communities.

Content may include:

  • Supporting creators.
  • Connecting communities.
  • Encouraging exploration.
  • Promoting shared experiences.

No additional navigation button is required.

8. Contact Us Section

The system shall provide a friendly contact section.

Requirements:

  • Display invitation for questions, feedback, or collaboration.
  • Provide Contact Us button.
  • Redirect users to contact channels.

Example copy:

"We'd love to hear from you! Have questions, feedback, or partnership ideas? Our team is here to help."

UI Requirements

Layout

  • Single-page scrolling layout.
  • No table of contents.
  • Storytelling flow from introduction to contact.
  • Clear spacing between sections.

Visual Design

The page should maintain:

  • Minimalist monochrome style.
  • Rounded cards.
  • Clean typography.
  • Consistent icon style.
  • Strong visual hierarchy.

Responsive Requirements

The system shall support:

  • Desktop.
  • Tablet.
  • Mobile devices.

Content cards and hero banner should adjust according to screen size.

Page Structure

Order of content:

  1. About Us Header
  2. Hero Banner / Our Story
  3. Platform Statistics
  4. Mission, Vision, What We Do, Values
  5. Our Team
  6. Community Impact
  7. Contact Us

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Page should load efficiently.
  • Images should be optimized.
  • Content should be accessible and readable.
  • Typography and spacing should support comfortable reading.
  • Administrators should be able to update About Us content without changing the design structure.

Based on pages-new.

Scope

  • Render the About Us content (from API or the i18n/legal source per the design); handle loading/empty/error. Standalone + OnPush; no BehaviorSubject, no any.

🧪 Test scenario (for QA)

  1. Open — the About Us page renders the full content.
  2. Links — external/internal links route correctly.
  3. Error/empty — content fetch fail → clear message.
  4. Responsive + Light/Dark — desktop + 375px; both themes legible.

Acceptance: About Us content rendered via facade/source; loading/error handled; responsive; light + dark; no any.

issues.display_title: Issue #3162: Auto-focus panorama to hotspot on 'Hotspots in This Image' list click
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

On the post detail page, the sidebar list "Hotspots in This Image" doesn't take the user to a hotspot when a row is tapped (only "mention" rows react, and they navigate away to a profile). This task turns each row into a jump-to button: tapping it focuses the panorama viewer on that hotspot — switching to the plain (dewarp) view when a filter is active, gliding the camera to center the hotspot, and briefly highlighting the marker.

Brainstorming source: docs/brainstorming/2026-07-14-hotspot-auto-focus-on-list-click.md (branch product-docs).

Behaviour on tap

Tapping a hotspot row plays a short, guided sequence:

  1. Switch to plain view if needed — if the viewer shows a filtered / little-planet look, switch to the normal dewarp view (hotspots are only visible there).
  2. Smoothly glide the camera so the hotspot is centered — no instant snapping.
  3. Briefly highlight the marker (pulse) when the glide finishes.

Applies to every hotspot row (mention and content) for a consistent list.

Mentions keep "open profile"

Since tapping the row now focuses the viewer, opening a profile moves to its own tap target:

  • Tap the row (elsewhere) → focus the viewer on the hotspot.
  • Tap the avatar / name → open that person's profile.

Behaviour rules

Situation What happens
Tap any hotspot row Viewer focuses on that hotspot (glide + highlight)
Viewer in filtered / little-planet mode Switch to plain dewarp view first, then focus
Viewer already in plain view Just glide and highlight — no mode change
Tap avatar / name on a mention row Open that person's profile (does NOT focus)
Tap same row again Re-play the highlight so the tap is always acknowledged
Hotspot has no saved location Row does not focus; a mention row can fall back to opening the profile — never a broken state

Details

  • Mobile: the photo sits above the sidebar list — after a tap, bring the panorama into sight (scroll/reveal) so the user sees the glide.
  • Motion: smooth and reasonably quick — guided, not sluggish, not a jarring snap.
  • Highlight: a short nudge for the eye, not a permanent marker change.
  • Continuity: pairs with the "hotspot guidance in filtered image mode" feature (same idea — hotspots live on the plain, non-filtered photo).

Acceptance criteria

  • Tapping any hotspot row moves the viewer so that hotspot is centered and easy to find.
  • If a filter was active, the viewer switches to the plain view so the hotspot is visible.
  • The marker highlights briefly so the user knows which hotspot they landed on.
  • Mention rows still open the profile via the avatar / name.
  • On mobile, the user can see the focus happen without manually scrolling.
  • A hotspot with no saved location never causes a broken or dead tap.

Out of scope

  • Changing how hotspots are created, styled, or saved; adding new hotspot types/data.
  • Changing the filter / dewarp modes themselves (only switching between existing ones).
  • Any behaviour on create/edit screens — this is the detail (view) page only.
  • Translations (handled via the app's normal translation flow).

Generated from the approved brainstorming doc. Full write-up (with sketch) at docs/brainstorming/2026-07-14-hotspot-auto-focus-on-list-click.md.

issues.display_title: Issue #3190: Integrate Delete Local File Panorama on Draft Post
issues.main_description_html:
🧹 Integrate — Delete Local (not-yet-uploaded) Panorama on Draft Post

Handle removing a local panorama — one that has not been uploaded to the draft yet — in the new pages-new create/edit-draft flow. This is client-side only (no API).

Based on pages-new (create/images-list, create.component.onRemoveImage). Pairs with existing-file delete (#3189).

Context

Each panorama is a CreatePanoramaImage:

  • needUpload: true → a locally-held file (file / dropboxPath, previewUrl blob) added in the wizard but not yet uploaded.
  • Removing it should be purely local — remove from the images() signal, revoke the object URL (previewUrl) to avoid leaks, and fix selectedImageIndex + thumbnail. No delete API call.
  • Files are only uploaded on Publish/Save Draft — a local file has no server representation to delete.

Scope

  • images-list (removeImage) → create.component.onRemoveImage(id): for a needUpload: true item, remove locally (revoke blob URL), reassign thumbnail/selection; do not hit any API. Distinguish from uploaded items (#3189 handles those). Signal-driven; no any.

🧪 Test scenario (for QA)

  1. Remove local — add a panorama (browse/Dropbox, not published), remove it → it disappears instantly; no network request fires.
  2. No leak — the removed file's object URL is revoked (no lingering blob).
  3. Thumbnail/selection — removing the thumbnail/active local item reassigns thumbnail + selection; if it was the only image, the wizard returns to the empty state.
  4. Mixed list — with both local and uploaded panoramas, removing a local one is local-only (uploaded ones follow #3189).
  5. No errors — no console errors; live preview updates correctly.

Acceptance: local (needUpload) panorama removed client-side only (no API), blob URL revoked, thumbnail/selection fixed; correctly distinguished from uploaded panoramas; no any.

issues.display_title: Issue #3189: Integrate API Delete Existing file Panorama on Draft Post
issues.main_description_html:
🔌 Integrate API — Delete Existing (uploaded) Panorama on Draft Post

Wire deleting an already-uploaded panorama from a draft post (server-side) in the new pages-new create/edit-draft flow.

Based on pages-new (create/*, edit-draft). Pairs with local-file delete (#3190).

Context

In the create wizard, each panorama is a CreatePanoramaImage:

  • needUpload: false → the file already exists on the draft (uploaded), identified by id (= u_name) on the backend.
  • Removing such a panorama must call the BE delete API (delete panorama from the draft by sid + u_name/id), then remove it from the local images() signal only on success.

🔗 Endpoint (BE)

  • ⚠️ Confirm the exact delete endpoint from BE (e.g. POST/DELETE {{base_url}}/posts/draft/delete-panorama or .../:sid/panorama/:u_name) — payload: sid (draft id) + u_name/id of the panorama. Wire it via a facade/service. ec/auth headers as per the create endpoints.

Scope

  • On removing an uploaded panorama in edit-draft: call the delete API via the facade; show loading/disabled on that item; on success remove it from images() + fix selectedImageIndex/thumbnail; on failure keep it and show a clear error. Confirm before delete (destructive). No BehaviorSubject, no any.
  • Edge: removing the current thumbnail reassigns thumbnail; removing the last panorama handled per design.

🧪 Test scenario (for QA)

  1. Delete uploaded — in an edited draft, remove a panorama that was already uploaded → delete API fires with sid + u_name; on success it disappears.
  2. Confirm — Cancel aborts with no API call.
  3. Thumbnail/selection — removing the thumbnail/active item reassigns thumbnail + selection sensibly.
  4. Error — API fail → panorama stays; clear error; retry possible; no double-submit.
  5. Persistence — re-open the draft → the deleted panorama is gone server-side.

Acceptance: uploaded panorama deleted via BE API (by sid+u_name) with confirm; local list synced only on success; thumbnail/selection + error handled; no any.

issues.display_title: Issue #3175: [Add Post] Integrate Hotspot Guidance in Filtered Image Mode (Step 1 & 2)
issues.main_description_html:
🔌 [Add Post] Integrate Hotspot Guidance in Filtered Image Mode (Step 1 & 2)

Implement the hotspot guidance behaviour in the new pages-new Create Post flow: two inline info banners + the Step 2 viewer auto-switching to the un-filtered view when a creative filter is applied.

UI task (result): panorra-pwa#3161 · UI branch: UIUX-update/hotspot-guidance · Source doc: docs/brainstorming/2026-07-14-hotspot-filtered-mode-guidance.md. Based on pages-new.

Why

When a creative filter (Little Planet, Dome, Sky Hole, …) is applied, the image is warped and hotspots only appear on the plain/un-filtered version — today nothing tells the user, so hotspots seem to disappear.

Scope (pages-new/create)

Moment 1 — Step 1 (Upload & Filter) — create/filter/*

  • Show an info banner only when a creative filter is ON, directly below the filter toggle / filter picker in the left sidebar.
  • Copy: Hotspots are only visible when the image filter is turned off.

Moment 2 — Step 2 (Add Hotspots) — create/hotspot-banner/*

  • Show an info banner only when the post has a filter applied, above the hotspot panel.
  • Copy: This post uses a filtered image. Hotspots appear on the non-filtered version — but you can still add them here.
  • Auto-switch the panorama preview to the normal, un-filtered view so hotspots are placeable/visible — e.g. pass no filter to app-view-panorama while on Step 2. The published post keeps its filter — do not mutate the stored filter state (drive it from a computed(), not an effect() side-effect).

No filter applied — neither banner shows; viewer behaves normally.

Show / hide rules

Situation Step 1 note Step 2 note Step 2 viewer
No filter applied Hidden Hidden Normal view
Filter turned on Shown (under filter picker) Shown (above hotspot panel) Auto-switch to un-filtered view
Filter turned off on Step 1 Hides immediately Hidden on Step 2 Normal view

Visual tone

  • Informational/helpful — not an error/warning; no red; not a toast/tooltip.
  • Muted background, small ℹ️ icon, short text, full sidebar width, rounded corners consistent with Create Post panels; Tailwind 4 / Zard UI semantic tokens (light + dark).
  • Standalone + OnPush; signal/computed()-driven; no any.
  • Copy goes through the normal i18n flow.

✅ Acceptance criteria (from #3161)

  • Applying a filter always shows the Step 1 note.
  • On Step 2, a filtered post shows the plain photo so every hotspot lands where intended.
  • The Step 2 note appears and reassures the user hotspots still work.
  • A user with no filter sees neither note and experiences no change.
  • Notes read as friendly information, never as errors.
  • Copy avoids technical words like "dewarp".
  • Publishing still keeps the applied filter (viewer switch is presentation-only).

🧪 Test scenario (for QA)

  1. No filter — Step 1 & 2 show no banner; viewer normal; no behaviour change.
  2. Filter ON (Step 1) — banner appears under the filter picker immediately.
  3. Filter OFF again — Step 1 banner hides immediately; Step 2 shows none.
  4. Step 2 with filter — banner shows above the hotspot panel and the preview renders the plain/un-filtered image; hotspots land exactly where placed.
  5. Publish — the published post still has the filter applied (viewer switch didn't persist).
  6. Light/Dark + responsive — banners legible in both themes, 375px + desktop; no console errors.

Out of scope

  • Changing how filters or hotspots themselves work/look.
  • Rendering hotspots on top of a filtered image (separate, larger effort).
